svg.aria-label: Stage 1 is done; finish it at laptop scale before adding SAE bases
svg.text: Stage 1 is done; finish it at laptop scale before adding SAE bases
Stage 1 · Neuron basis
done
Streaming moments, histograms, top-k and residual covariance for every MLP neuron and residual dimension.
Validated on 1M OpenWebText tokens on an M4: exact two-shard merge, pointers reproduce on recompute.
Gate passed: merge-exactness tests and pointer recompute
Stage 1b · Harden at laptop scale
in progress
Done: accumulators tuned (+61%), notebook, one window per document, bootstrap over 8 shards, residual bottom-k.
Next: deep scans of single units, a real corpus systematic (FineWeb or code).
Gate: each SAE reproduces its release's variance explained, CE loss recovered and L0 on our pipeline
Stage 2 · Pretrained SAE bases
planned
SAELens residual SAEs (Bloom 24k, OpenAI 32k / 128k) in the same hooks; sparse feature events to Parquet.
Compare features with neurons; test whether features track the IOI circuit and its Hydra repair.
Gate: a question pretrained dictionaries cannot answer
Stage 3 · Train our own SAEs
only if needed
For an uncovered hook point (e.g. per-head hook_z), a different corpus, or dictionary-seed systematics.
A few hundred million tokens per layer; hours on one GPU with SAELens.
